# w.scrpt 0.1.0 RC24 checkpoint

Date: 2026-07-28

Worktree: `/path/to/projects/w.scrpt`

## Scope

RC24 adds a searchable Jump List so navigation history works more like a streamlined IDE without requiring a sidebar.

- `Esc g j` opens Jump List.
- `:jumps`, `:jump-list`, `:jumplist`, and `:jump-history` open the same picker.
- The picker shows older, current, and newer jump locations with file/line/column labels when the buffer is open.
- Filtering uses the existing fuzzy prompt behavior.
- Selecting an existing location restores its file and cursor and records the origin as a new jump.
- Selecting the current location is a no-op with visible status.
- Stale closed file targets are revalidated before reopen; missing or non-file targets report an error instead of creating a new buffer.
- Existing Jump Back / Jump Forward restoration now shares the same stale-target guard.
- The generated keymap reference and action footer expose the new jump command.

## Proof boundary

This checkpoint is locally verified on the host Rust/PTY path. It is not a real iPad Magic Keyboard, Blink Shell, mosh, SSH, tmux, clipboard, touch, reconnect, or real language-server proof. Those remain manual QA gates in `docs/IPAD_BLINK_QA.md`.
